_comment: offramp verify --org <alias> --from out/real_org/extract --recipes config/verify_recipes.example.json [--roundtrip]. One entry per flow API name: object + create (and optional update) for record-triggered flows, inputs for autolaunched flows. Records are deleted after the run. Autolaunched flows may reference the created record as "$record.Id" in inputs. Scheduled and screen flows are not verifiable on demand.
